Q1_where_the_worker_session_id_is_minted.mintedBy: the Palimpsest DSH host bundle, inside the runWorker call to agents.create
Q1_where_the_worker_session_id_is_minted.note: the id is a CANDIDATE minted before creation; the authoritative identity is what DSH returns for the created session

observedCallChain: host runner: await agents.create({ sessionId, meta, agentOptions, setup })
AgentLoop.createAgent: await this.createStoredSession(preparation.session)  <-- the session is STORED here
AgentLoop.createAgent: setupAndPublish(...) -> initializeAgent -> prepare -> setup?(...) -> publish(source)
Q2_where_the_session_becomes_a_real_publ.note: the session exists and is stored BEFORE setup runs and BEFORE publication; a successful create therefore yields a real session identity independently of any later turn

Q3_where_the_host_could_report_it_before.identityAvailableOnHandle: handle.agent.session.id (AgentRegistry asserts agent.id === session.id, and the principal path already reads String(agent.session.id))
Q3_where_the_host_could_report_it_before.note: the created identity is available from the returned handle immediately after create resolves, and the first model turn is a LATER statement — so a report emitted between them cannot depend on the model's answer

Q4_where_the_parent_currently_receives_i.ipcStdio: stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe", "ipc"]  // stdio[3] is the ONE child IPC channel
Q4_where_the_parent_currently_receives_i.note: the parent owns the direct child's IPC channel and already parses ONE strict structured message shape on it

Q5_why_context_pull_is_not_an_identity_r.direction: child -> parent REQUEST (kind: 'pull'), parent -> child RESPONSE (kind: 'pull-result')
Q5_why_context_pull_is_not_an_identity_r.reason: the pull protocol names a CONTEXT HANDLE and nothing else; neither direction carries the worker's DSH SessionId, and the parent's answer is a canonical body rather than an identity. A pull that never happens leaves the parent with no session identity at all
Q5_why_context_pull_is_not_an_identity_r.handlerTreatsUnknownEnvelope: returns early when parseWorkerPullEnvelope is undefined — an identity-shaped message would be silently DROPPED today

Q6_where_the_invocation_id_is_minted.owner: the Parent Deployment Worker Port, one per port invocation
Q6_where_the_invocation_id_is_minted.note: the port mints it and the parent already owns the spawned object, so the parent is the correct owner of the invocation identity

Q7_where_the_attempt_id_is_attached_to_h.mechanism: correlateObservations(sink, { hostLocalJobId, attemptId }) wraps the sink and stamps the identity onto each observation
Q7_where_the_attempt_id_is_attached_to_h.attemptSource: prepared.attemptId from deps.controller.prepareMutatingWork(...) — the canonical Work owner
Q7_where_the_attempt_id_is_attached_to_h.invocationSource: observation.invocationId, ADOPTED from the producer (the port), never minted here
Q7_where_the_attempt_id_is_attached_to_h.note: this is the one host-private boundary that legitimately holds the canonical AttemptId and its own job id; it is where a correlated Session identity belongs

Q8_where_the_host_job_id_is_attached.blockingPath: correlateObservations(..., { hostLocalJobId: "", attemptId: prepared.attemptId }) — the blocking kernel has NO host job, so it supplies the empty string rather than inventing one
Q8_where_the_host_job_id_is_attached.note: host-local and non-durable; the blocking path deliberately has none, and a correlated identity must not fabricate one

missing: the actual created DSH SessionId is never read into a report on the Work route
no structured Host -> Parent identity message exists on the IPC channel
the parent has no Session Identity parser branch on spawned.on('message')
the parent therefore records no per-invocation observed session identity
no correlation layer can attach a real DSH SessionId to the canonical AttemptId
Q9_which_facts_are_missing_for_real_sess.note: the identity EXISTS at runtime (the handle exposes it) but nothing transports or records it

Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.capabilityRefusal: a refused worker still throws 'refusing to run this worker: ...' and reports HOST_FAILURE — a created session must not be relabelled as work success
Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.workerResultContract: PALIMPSEST_WORK_RESULT and parseWorkWorkerResult are unchanged; an identity report is NOT a work result
Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.contextPullAllowlist: parseWorkerPullEnvelope and workerPullHandleAllowed are unchanged; the pull protocol stays independent
Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.workerPayloadBytes: workWorkerEnvironmentPayload output stays byte-identical; the identity is host-side, not model-visible
Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.settlementAuthority: prepareMutatingWork / settleMutatingWork are untouched; an observed SessionId settles nothing
Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.hostObservationSchema: HostProcessObservation keeps its shape; the session identity is a SEPARATE observation, never smuggled into hostFailureDetail
Q10_existing_semantics_that_must_not_cha.h1BindingResolver: resolveVerifiedSessionBinding is untouched; a P2-A observation is NOT durable binding evidence and must not reach BOUND_VERIFIED

installed_bundle_measurement.note: measured against the INSTALLED bundle, not only the working tree, so the answer describes what would actually run

smallestSupportedIntegrationPoint.producer: host/dsh/lib/runner.js runWorker: report handle.agent.session.id on the existing stdio[3] IPC channel after create succeeds and before the first followup
smallestSupportedIntegrationPoint.consumer: src/deployment/work_worker.ts: a strict Session Identity parser branch on spawned.on('message'), associating the identity with the port's OWN invocationId
smallestSupportedIntegrationPoint.correlation: src/interaction/work_delegation.ts: an optional correlated session-identity sink that reuses the existing AttemptId/JobId ownership
smallestSupportedIntegrationPoint.whyNotStdout: stdout is model-writable, so a stdout line is worker testimony; the IPC channel is owned by the host bundle and is not reachable by the model

note: no finding here authorizes PRIMARY execution, a durable binding or automatic Handoff
method: read the shipped host bundle, the Parent worker port, the Work Delegation correlation layer and the installed first-party DSH agent factory; measure the absence on the isolated worker region
expectedInvariant: the Work route mints a candidate session id and never transports or records the created identity
remainingUncertainty: the runtime behaviour of a real worker host is measured separately in the Level C integration evidence
